Create the file case_120.inp in the current working directory using the exact input deck content provided by the user, including all comments, node definitions, element definitions, boundary conditions, material, section, node sets, transform, and step sections verbatim.
Run the command ccx -i case_120 in the working directory. If that command fails or is not recognized, fall back to ccx case_120.
Record the exact command that was used for the run.
After the run completes, read the file case_120.sta and check for the string JOB COMPLETED to determine success.
Obtain the CalculiX version string by running ccx -v (or the closest equivalent command available on the system).
Write a file named results.json in the working directory containing a JSON object with exactly these keys: solver (set to "calculix"), case_id (set to "case_120"), status (set to "success" if JOB COMPLETED was found in the .sta file, otherwise "error"), ccx_version (set to the version string obtained from the version query), artifacts (set to an empty list), and notes (set to a string containing the exact ccx command used; if the run failed, also include the error message and the name of the file that indicated the failure).
Do not modify any values in the input deck.
Do not add, remove, or alter any physics parameters, node coordinates, element connectivity, boundary conditions, material properties, or step definitions.
